cards.title: function
cards.body: `function` creates a named block of code that runs whenever you call it by name.

hi.title: function
hi.body: `function` code ka ek naam wala block banata hai jo jab bhi uska naam call karo, chalta hai.

cards.title: Parameters and return
cards.body: Values go in through parameters in the brackets. `return` sends a result back to whoever called the function.

hi.title: Parameters aur return
hi.body: Values brackets ke andar parameters se andar aati hain. `return` result ko wapas usko bhejta hai jisne function call kiya.

cards.title: return is not console.log
cards.body: `console.log` only shows a value. `return` hands it back, so the caller can keep using it.

hi.title: return, console.log nahi hai
hi.body: `console.log` value sirf dikhata hai. `return` use wapas deta hai, taaki call karne wala use aage use kar sake.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print 13, but prints 12 and then `NaN`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `console.log` only shows the value, so `triple` gives back `undefined`. Line 2 should be `return n * 3;`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 13 print karna chahiye, par yeh 12 aur phir `NaN` print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `console.log` sirf value dikhata hai, isliye `triple` wapas `undefined` deta hai. Line 2 `return n * 3;` honi chahiye.

exercise.prompt: Finish the function `square(n)` so it returns `n * n`. The code below reads a number and prints `square` of it.
exercise.promptHi: Function `square(n)` poora karo taaki woh `n * n` return kare. Neeche ka code ek number padhta hai aur uska `square` print karta hai.
